text:
Ivy: Tiny office library idea  everyone leaves one pocket-sized book on the shelf, swap freely. Thoughts? :book:
Marco: Love it. 'Pocket library' is very indie and very cool. Count me in.
Sana: Quick poll: react :one: if you want fiction, :two: for nonfic, :three: for comics/graphic novellas.
Theo: I'll sponsor the first 'mystery paperback' drop. One-liner challenge: best 6-word book blurb wins first pick. Go.
Ivy: Rules: label with name + genre + 'take-one-leave-one'. Keep it tiny (under 200 pages) so it fits the shelf.
Marco: One-liner entry: "Lost ring, found map, slightly cursed cat."
Sana: "Skipping pages, collecting awkward life advice."
Theo: "Plot twist: the librarian was an alien." :alien:
book-bot: Reminder: please avoid food-stained books. Clean returns only. Also, add titles to #book-shelf-log.
Ivy: Voting notes: react to this thread for the genre poll. Book blurb winners will get first pick of the mystery paperback.
Marco: Also, tiny stickers will be available to mark your books 'do not hog'. Sticker logistics on the fridge.
Sana: If anyone leaves a cookbook, I claim dibs. Tiny recipes = tiny miracles.
Theo: Tally: 1s leading, 2 close behind. Comic lovers, make noise.
Ivy: Final housekeeping: shelf lives on the sideboard by the conference room. Please respect quiet reading hours at 3pm.
Marco: Prize for best blurb: first peek at the mystery paperback + a tasteful bookmark.
Sana: "Tiny library, giant feelings." That's my mic-drop.
Ivy: Great turnout. I'll post a starter list of books in #book-shelf-log later today. Happy swapping! :sparkles:
